tools.name: launchfiles_billing_list_providers
tools.description: List payment providers available for agent checkout (id, enabled, mode, rails). Discover-only; does not spend or mutate ledger.

tools.name: launchfiles_billing_create_checkout
tools.description: Create provider-agnostic agent checkout. Returns payment_url and/or x402 challenge plus poll_url. Poll until paid to receive agent_api_key once. Does not debit credits or publish.

tools.name: launchfiles_billing_poll_checkout
tools.description: Poll an agent checkout until settled. When paid, returns agent_api_key once and, for page_draft_long, an unlock_token. Does not spend.

tools.name: launchfiles_request_agent_key
tools.description: Primary agentic mint. Emails a one-time approve link to an allowlisted or approved-waitlist address. Returns poll_token. Does not mint a key until the link is opened. Rejects other addresses. Optional partner_id mints an lf_agent_ key whose scopes carry that partner claim (allowlist only). Omit part

tools.name: launchfiles_poll_agent_key
tools.description: Collect the lf_agent_ key once after the approve link is opened. Pending until then. Second poll redacts the secret.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_standalone_search_repair_radar_free · Private data: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_poll_agent_key · Public sink: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_billing_create_checkout, launchfiles_standalone_page_draft_short.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_standalone_search_repair_radar_free · Private data: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_poll_agent_key · Public sink: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_billing_create_checkout, launchfiles_standalone_page_draft_short

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
